title: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction
description: Amershi et al. (CHI 2019) propose 18 validated design guidelines for how AI systems should behave during interaction with people.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
description: Daniel Kahneman on the two systems of thought and the cognitive biases that shape judgment and decision-making.

title: People + AI Guidebook
description: Google PAIR's practical guide for designing human-centered AI products, covering mental models, trust, feedback and errors.

title: APA Center for Behavioral Science and AI
description: A new American Psychological Association initiative bringing stakeholders together to build human-centered AI, with evidence-based guidance and actionable frameworks for product decisions. Built on three commitments (ethics and privacy, health and well-being, equity and bias reduction), starting with youth digital well-being.

title: Robert Sapolsky: From Slime Mold to Superintelligence
description: Neuroscientist Robert Sapolsky in conversation with The Behavioral AI Institute, moving from simple biological systems to superintelligence and what behavioral science brings to thinking about AI.

title: Appropriate Reliance on Generative AI: Research Synthesis
description: Passi, Dhanorkar and Vorvoreanu (Microsoft Research, 2024) synthesize around 50 papers on overreliance on generative AI. Appropriate reliance means accepting correct AI outputs and rejecting incorrect ones; the report covers the factors that drive overreliance and strategies to mitigate it.
